text.constantValue: Weekday Happy Hour: Monday through Friday from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM. Includes rotating specials on house cocktails, local draft beers, shareable appetizers, and select single-patty burgers.
Weekend Brunch Menu: Available every Saturday and Sunday from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM, featuring brunch burgers, brisket hash, chicken & waffles, breakfast tacos, and craft mimosas.

Kids Menu: Tailored for guests 12 and under. Includes a choice of cheeseburger, grilled chicken tenders, mac & cheese, or buttered pasta, served with hand-cut fries or seasonal fresh fruit and a fountain drink.
